description: This file contains functions and types related to subagent announcement flow, including building prompts, handling session wake messages, and executing the announcement process in a distributed agent system.

methods.name: buildSubagentSystemPrompt
methods.description: Generates a detailed prompt template for subagents based on provided parameters, including rules, role, and session context.

methods.name: buildAnnounceReplyInstruction
methods.description: Creates instructions for how a subagent should convert its completion result into an internal or user-facing message, depending on context.

methods.name: buildAnnounceSteerMessage
methods.description: Formats internal agent events into a prompt message for steering or processing.

methods.name: hasUsableSessionEntry
methods.description: Checks if a session entry object has a valid sessionId string.

methods.name: buildDescendantWakeMessage
methods.description: Constructs a message to wake a descendant subagent after waiting for its completion.

methods.name: stripWakeRunSuffixes
methods.description: Removes ':wake' suffixes from a run ID string.

methods.name: isWakeContinuationRun
methods.description: Determines if a run ID indicates a wake continuation based on suffix.

methods.name: wakeSubagentRunAfterDescendants
methods.description: Sends a wake message to a descendant subagent and updates its run ID if successful.

methods.name: runSubagentAnnounceFlow
methods.description: Main function to execute the subagent announcement flow, handling session state, output reading, and message delivery.
